sources.excerpt:
Fuzzrocious Pedals CAT KING | AllThePedals Articles Genealogy Browse Search results for " " Gain / Distortion / Fuzzrocious Pedals CAT KING CAT KING The Fuzzrocious Pedals Cat King is a versatile distortion pedal, a "king-sized" version of the Cat Tail, offering low to high gain overdrive and distortion sounds. Based on a classic distortion circuit, it can transform a clean amp into something dirty, and a dirty amp into something much more extreme. Optimized for both guitar and bass, the Cat King features a diode toggle for clipping options, and the Beavis double resistor mod (Clipping 1 and 2 pots) for fine-tuning high and low frequencies. It's a great option if you're looking for a Rat style pedal. What Fuzzrocious Pedals say about the CAT KING What is the CAT KING? The Cat King is the “king sized” version of our Cat Tail, a low to high gain distortion with overdrive capabilities (some even say at high gain settings, it sounds like a fuzz). This circuit is based on a well-loved, classic distortion that make a clean amp dirty and a dirty amp disgusting. We have tweaked the original circuit to better meet the needs of guitarists and bassists alike. With the addition of a diode toggle for extra tweakability for clipping options, we have added to the modifications the Beavis double resistor mod (Clipping 1 and 2 pots) to allow the user to subtly fine tune how the signal clips on the highs and lows. Please view the for more information about the pedal. PLEASE NOTE This is in fact the pedal known formerly known as “Rat King.” We changed the name in July 2015 to avoid product confusion. The circuit remains the same. fuzzrociouspedals.com CAT KING compared to ...
